title: Send Outlook email with AI after a recipient check
h1: send an outlook email with the details checked
description: Let a bot prepare and send an Outlook email with a subject, body and optional files. Review recipients and attachments using Dusk Bot's sending controls.
answer: you can give a bot the recipient, subject and message to send through outlook, with optional files and cc or bcc recipients. this action sends the email rather than leaving a draft. it asks first by default, unless you grant a daily sending amount; a bot on full access with no sending rule may send up to 25 a day without asking.
og_line: the right message to the right address.
what:
send email needs a primary recipient, subject and body. the bot takes those from your request and can attach a single file or several files. each attachment must be non-empty and include a valid name and file type. ask for a preview that names the files, not just "attachment included".

you can request a different from address only when the mailbox has the appropriate send-as or send-on-behalf permission. specifying an address does not grant that permission. use plain text unless the message really needs html, and keep the body format consistent with that choice.
uses: email an approved delivery note to the warehouse contact you specify
send a workshop access letter with its final pdf attached
circulate a short internal notice to a fixed recipient list
send a new supplier request without pretending it is a reply in an old thread

routine.message: every thursday at 10:10, prepare an outlook email to the approved distribution contact for rivermint ceramics using the final dispatch note i attached here. show me the full recipient address, subject, body and attachment name and wait for approval before sending. save a sent-items copy and confirm the send here. never substitute a recipient, attach an unfinished file or resend after an unclear result without checking with me.
routine.needs: outlook connected, with read and write access; sending set to **Ask every time**
routine.output:
outlook email ready for review
to: agathe at rivermint ceramics, using the approved contact address
subject: dispatch note for the kiln shelves
attachment: final-dispatch-note.pdf
not sent yet.

steps: use **Connected apps** to connect the outlook mailbox and grant the dispatch bot **read and write** access.
set **Sending on your behalf** to **Ask every time**, especially when the bot has **Full access**.
give the real email address and the final file, then ask for a full preview before allowing the send.
inspect the first sent-items copy and the result in chat before relying on a repeating dispatch routine.
watch: a bot on **Full access** with no sending rule may send up to 25 emails a day without asking. set **Sending on your behalf** to **Ask every time** to review each one.
a from address needs mailbox permission, and a display name cannot replace a usable recipient address.
empty files or attachments missing a valid name or file type can make the email fail.

faq.q: can it send the same email to more than one person?
faq.a: yes. the primary recipient field accepts comma-separated addresses, while cc and bcc use separate address lists. review all three before approving.

faq.q: can it send from our shared mailbox?
faq.a: the action accepts a from address, but the connected account must have appropriate mailbox permissions. naming the mailbox alone is not enough.
